tecnifibre-t-fight-305s: Precise, stable and quick through the air, with big serves. The grip shape divides players.
wilson-rf-01-pro: Lovely on one-handers, with easy power and a small sweet spot. Long matches feel longer.
yonex-vcore-98-8th-gen: Big serves, easy power and heavy spin. The high launch can send balls long.
babolat-pure-aero-98-gen9: Comfortable and controlled, but muted. The previous generation's fans are still in mourning.
babolat-pure-aero-98-gen8: Big spin, easy power and strong serves. Many report elbow or wrist pain.
head-speed-mp-2022: A balanced all-rounder with easy power. Plenty say the later Speeds never quite caught up.
wilson-pro-staff-97-v14: Solid, stable and precise, like Pro Staffs past. Power is strictly bring your own.
babolat-pure-drive-gen11: Softer and more stable than before, with easy power. The paint is less committed.
head-gravity-tour-2025: A generous sweet spot for its size, with control and spin. You supply the pace.
babolat-pure-aero-gen9: Heavy spin and a more comfortable ride than before, with a more muted feel.
head-speed-mp-2026: Connected, stable and comfortable. Many call it a return to form after the last Speed.
yonex-percept-100: Control and comfort, with more sweet spot than the smaller Percept. Swing out for power.
yonex-percept-97: Lovely feel, spin and touch at the net. Tired swings get no sympathy whatsoever.
yonex-ezone-98-7th-gen: Many prefer it to the newer EZONE. Easy power and spin, though shots can sail long.
wilson-ultra-99-pro-v5: Spin and easy power from the open pattern. Your stringer will be glad of the business.
head-speed-mp-2024: Heavy swingweight and tricky timing. Stick with it and the power and stability show up.
babolat-pure-aero-gen8: Easy power and spin that can run long. Elbow trouble eased for some at lower tension.
yonex-vcore-98-7th-gen: Fans love the spin, whip and plush feel. Others find it underpowered and hard to control.
yonex-percept-100d: Stable, precise and more forgiving than its sibling. Lead tape is a popular accessory.
wilson-pro-staff-x-v14: Precise and forgiving for a heavy frame. The weight can tire the arm and wrist.
yonex-ezone-98-8th-gen: Forgiving and comfortable with free power. Feedback arrives by second-class post.
wilson-shift-99-v1: A topspin machine with a comfortable feel. At the net, it's less of a showman.
wilson-shift-99-pro-v1: Spin, power and control from a denser pattern. Demanding, and string setup really matters.
wilson-rf-01: Quick, controlled and full of touch. The sweet spot is small, and some add weight.
wilson-blade-98-16x19-v9: A connected control frame that rewards full swings. Expect little free power.
yonex-vcore-100d-8th-gen: Stable with real plough-through, but many find it heavy and slow to swing.
yonex-vcore-95-7th-gen: Control, spin and comfort for big, aggressive swings. Many owners simply stop shopping.
tecnifibre-t-fight-300s: Spin, control and power in a quick frame. Some add lead for stability.
head-speed-tour-2026: Controlled, stable and comfortable, with low power. Off-centre hits suffer.
head-gravity-pro-2025: Control you can trust, especially at the net. Depth has to be earned.
wilson-clash-100-v3: Chosen for arm comfort, and many say pain from stiffer frames eased. Stable and forgiving.
wilson-blade-pro-100-v10: Crisp volleys, strong serves and a stable yet whippy feel. Some add weight to time it.
yonex-vcore-95-8th-gen: Crisper and punchier than before, though some are still hunting for the difference.
wilson-blade-98-16x19-v10: More solid than the last Blade, with spin and control. Misses are rarely the racket's fault.
yonex-ezone-100-8th-gen: Easy pop, a big sweet spot and Clash-like comfort. The feel is a touch muted.
wilson-blade-100-v10: Placement and control, with more forgiveness and a touch more power than the smaller Blade.
wilson-blade-100-v9: Forgiving, balanced and easy to swing. Some wish it had a bit more personality.
wilson-clash-100-v2: Known for arm comfort and a big, forgiving sweet spot. The feel is muted.
wilson-ultra-100-v4: Free depth and easy power from a stiff frame. Some report elbow discomfort.
head-radical-mp-2023: Control, feel and precision, with a launch angle that keeps things down to earth.
head-gravity-pro-2023: Plush, stable and spinny, with power from a hefty swingweight. One-handers may find it heavy.
yonex-vcore-100-8th-gen: Whippy and spinny once the strings are sorted. Getting there is half the hobby.
wilson-blade-98-18x20-v9: Strong serves, fine control and lovely feel, but depth takes extra effort.
wilson-blade-pro-98-16x19-v9: Rock-solid feel and plenty of plough-through. Manoeuvring it is more like parallel parking.
wilson-pro-staff-97-v13: Crisp, controlled and a joy when struck clean. Many fans prefer it to its successor.
babolat-pure-aero-rafa-origin-gen8: Big power and stability, especially on serve. The high swingweight tires and punishes late swings.
